title: Bid requirements register
description: One row per requirement found in the customer's sources (RFP, annexes, questionnaires, demo scripts, Q&A). The register is the inventory every later artefact is checked against: compliance matrix, response documents, estimate, red team. Used by scripts/bid/build-compliance.js.

id.description: Stable ID with a prefix per area, e.g. OBJ-03, CHN-06, SUB-01, DEL-07, FUC1-02. Never renumber after the first issue.

src.description: Source document code from the source inventory, e.g. SRC-001 (RFP), SRC-002 (demo use cases).

loc.description: Location in the source: section, page, row or slide, e.g. '§3.1.2, p. 20'.

cat.description: Category, e.g. Functional – channels, Technical – integration, Submission, Deliverable, Commercial, Contractual, Security, Demo – <use case>.

mand.description: Yes | No | Not stated | Disqualifying. Use what the source says; do not upgrade or downgrade.

grp.description: Work group for answering and review, e.g. A functional, B AI and channels, C demo and technical, D contractual and submission.

text.description: The requirement in the customer's words (quote or close paraphrase), one obligation per row.

eval.description: Evaluation criterion or weight it feeds, when the source states one.

owner.description: Internal owner of the answer (internal register only).
